heading: Dispatches from the South
intro:
Three years on local buses, trucks, boats and on foot, from the Great Lakes to the Andes. These are the stories I wrote in English along the way: longer, slower, closer to a novel than a travel guide.

Read them in order, from the first border crossing to the most recent, or open whichever place calls you.
workTitle: Planning a programme in Latin America?
workText: I work with travel agencies as an independent destination specialist: designing routes, coordinating on the ground and leading small groups.
